title: Exact field scalar data on strict coefficient systems
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E\subset F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with their valuation rings, and a scheme $T$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the recorded strict coefficient towers and their abelian presentations [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], the normalized constructible predicates [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], and the completed coefficients and reductions [det-sp-reduction-tower-normalized]. Field-scalar system data means: the quotient maps induced by the integral field inclusion and their natural ring-tower map, the completed coefficient map commuting with all projections, one integral basis of rank $[F:E]$ with uniquely determined coordinates and its reductions at every level; an exact ordinary scalar-extension functor on whole strict systems whose evaluations are the recorded sheafified scalar models and whose transitions send $x\otimes b$ to $t(x)\otimes q(b)$; restriction preserving the same underlying sections and transitions; a natural coordinate isomorphism with the fixed finite power whose columns tensor with the reduced integral basis vectors; and the ordinary-derived scalar functor with universal localization counit, invertible on every complex, its levelwise scalar comparisons, preservation of normalized constructible systems, and preservation of each specified common cohomological and Tor interval. Scalar models and their tensor generators are those of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. This defines the data; it does not assert their existence.
